integrity: Closed-form derivation from Markov backward equations; separately implemented 5,000-case computational check. Scientific priority is not independently certified; no field-data or finite-horizon claims.
limitations: Two-patch, four-state continuous-time Markov model; no external immigration; positive local extinction rates; fixed linear sum of directional colonization rates; maximizes only unconditional mean time to complete extinction. The exact source date is supported by publicly available October 2001 publication metadata (2001-10-01); no earlier day-level public preprint was verified. Full text of one particularly relevant 2001 study was not available; originality remains provisional.
title: A sharp directed-rescue allocation law for two habitat patches
